content: Genio 520: MT8371 SoC, 2x Cortex-A78 + 6x Cortex-A55, Mali G57 MC2 GPU, 8th-gen MediaTek NPU up to 10 TOPS. Officially supported on Android and Yocto. CRITICAL: Generative AI / LLM inference via TFLite/LiteRT on Yocto is available now on Genio 720 but only 'expected Q2 2026' on Genio 520 -- confirms CPU-only LLM strategy is correct and NPU LLM path is officially immature on this exact board. Genio 520 and 720 are the only Genio platforms with ONNX Runtime NPU acceleration (MDLA NeuronExecutionProvider) on by default.
